description: We are LosSolfamidas: two brothers, one at university and one in high school, at our first hackathon. We love space, video games and building things together. We made AstroGame, a browser game that teaches children aged 7–12 how astronauts stay alive on Mars with real NASA data. We bring Godot game development, well-tested code and lots of curiosity. We'd love to meet people into pixel art, sound design or teaching science to kids.
